files.README.md:
# method-router

Fix lookup(routes, method): routes is a JSON object mapping HTTP method tokens to handler IDs (strings or numbers). Return the handler for the supplied method token under the HTTP method comparison rule, or null if absent. Read section 4.1 to decide whether case normalization is valid. Extension method tokens are supported. Do not infer missing methods or aliases.

Run: `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`.
Source: https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7231.txt (section 4.1 Request Methods: Overview).
Preserve the interface and tests. No dependencies; scratch data only in the system temporary directory.

Also open the short earlier HTTP specification excerpt https://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec5.html, section 5.1.1 (the comparison rule is within its first 1500 characters). The corresponding RFC 7231 text is later in that document; use read/grep on the web tool spill file to locate section 4.1 if truncated.
